name: Permanent Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: 5 years of temporary residence in Lithuania (or 5 years of residence in the EU with at least 2 uninterrupted years specifically in Lithuania).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of temporary residence in Lithuania.

requirements.blocker_text: A Lithuanian language and Constitution examination may be required; the specific pass level was not confirmed in this pass.
Ability to support oneself, set at EUR 1,153/month in 2026 (Lithuania's minimum wage); half this amount for minors.

outcome.duration_length: 5 years, renewable (residence itself is indefinite once granted; the card is periodically renewed)

sources.title: Migration Information Centre (immigration-services aggregator, not confirmed as an official government body) -- permanent residence: 5 years' temporary residence, language/Constitution test referenced without exam level, EUR 1,153/month income requirement (2026 minimum wage), criminal record certificate, health insurance, EUR 160/320 fees, 45-day to 3-month processing
